title: Trans Mountain System and Westridge (TMX)
dek: Canada's only pipeline to the West Coast: a twinned 890 kb/d system from Edmonton to Burnaby, with the Sumas spur feeding the 240 kb/d Puget Sound Pipeline to four Washington refineries, and the three-berth Westridge dock (630 kb/d maximum) loading partially laden Aframax tankers for Asia and the U.S. West Coast.
